sq.q: Why is Gray code preferred in digital systems like analog to digital converters?
answer: Gray code is preferred because only one bit changes at a time between successive values, which minimizes errors during transitions and improves accuracy and reliability in digital systems like analog to digital converters.

sq.q: What is the rule followed in BCD addition when the sum exceeds 9 or an illegal code appears?
answer: In BCD addition , if the sum of 4-bit digits exceeds 9 (1001) or generates an illegal BCD code , then add 0110 (6) to the result to correct it.
